def cand(t):
    Hh,Ww=len(t),len(t[0])
    res=[[0]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]
    for i in range(Hh):
        for j in range(Ww):

            v = any(ii<i for ii in col9s) and any(ii>i for ii in col9s)
            res[i][j]=2 if (h or v) else 4
    return res

from collections import Counter
def gapstats(ii,oo,MK):
    H,W=len(ii),len(ii[0])
    exp={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if oo[i][j]!=ii[i][j]}
    rs=Counter(); cs=Counter(); ur=Counter(); uc=Counter()
    for i in range(H):
        pos=[j for j in range(W) if ii[i][j]==MK]
        for a,b in zip(pos,pos[1:]):
            n=b-a-1
            got=sum(1 for k in range(a+1,b) if (i,k) in exp)
            if got==n: rs[n]+=1
            elif got: ur[n]+=1
    for j in range(W):
        pos=[i for i in range(H) if ii[i][j]==MK]
        for a,b in zip(pos,pos[1:]):
            n=b-a-1
            got=sum(1 for k in range(a+1,b) if (k,j) in exp)
            if got==n: cs[n]+=1
            elif got: uc[n]+=1
